title: MS Military Police Lieutenant Colonel Found Dead in Campo Grande
seoTitle: MS Military Police Lieutenant Colonel Found Dead in Campo.
subtitle: Body Discovered on Tamandaré Avenue After Gunshots Mistaken for Motorcycle Noise
excerpt: A retired Military Police lieutenant colonel was found dead with a gunshot wound to the chest on Tamandaré Avenue, Campo Grande, prompting a police investigation.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A retired Mato Grosso do Sul Military Police lieutenant colonel was found dead on Sunday morning on Tamandaré Avenue, in Campo Grande, after gunshots were initially mistaken for the sound of a motorcycle.

How the body was discovered

A customer at a nearby gas station spotted the man lying on the street. Gas station employees heard the shots but believed them to be motorcycle noise. Upon realizing the situation, the customer alerted the employees, who then called the police.

Scene Details

The lieutenant colonel had a gunshot wound to the chest and was found next to a weapon. The area was cordoned off, and forensics carried out the necessary procedures to clarify the death.

Sexual Abuse Allegation

In August, the officer's daughter, now 33, reported her 52-year-old father for statutory rape and other crimes against sexual dignity. She reported abuses that began at age 9, with the first forced sexual intercourse at age 13, and pressures starting at age 15. The complaint also mentions threats with a firearm to silence the victim.

Other Victims Mentioned in the Complaint

The daughter stated that she had witnessed her father sexually molesting her brother's daughter, and that her own brother had also been a victim of abuse in childhood. The document indicates that these episodes had already led to legal and police actions against the investigated individual.

Victim Assistance

In Campo Grande, the Grupo Amor Vida (GAV) offers free emotional support via telephone 0800 750 5554. Assistance can also be sought at the Mental Health Nucleus, at CAPS (Psychosocial Care Center), or by calling 188 of CVV (Life Valorization Center). In emergency situations, the Military Police (190) and Fire Department (193) numbers can be called.

With information from Campo Grande News.
